cli.usage:
Usage:
  mytgfs version    print version and runtime (supports --json)
  mytgfs auth bot    log in with a bot token
  mytgfs auth user   log in with a phone number (code at runtime)
  mytgfs channel init --bot <username>  create private channel and grant bot admin
  mytgfs volume create --name <name>  create a volume, invite bot, mute notifications
  mytgfs volume delete --name <name>  delete the volume's channel and local index
  mytgfs volume check  verify every volume channel is still usable
  mytgfs webdav [--addr 127.0.0.1:8080] [--name volume]  start the WebDAV server
  mytgfs unmap --addr 127.0.0.1:8080  remove network mappings pointing at this server
  mytgfs cp [--name volume] [--to target] [--force] <src> <dst>  reference-copy a file
  mytgfs put [--name volume] [--remote /dir] <local files or dirs...>  batch upload
  mytgfs sync        rebuild local index from channel history
  mytgfs umount [--point Y:]  safely remove mount (all if omitted)
  mytgfs daemon start|status|stop  background daemon
  mytgfs web [--port N]  local web dashboard
  mytgfs tray [--port N]  system tray: mount, auto sync, dashboard
  mytgfs startup enable|disable|status  start at login (off by default)

Environment:
  MYTGFS_API_ID  override default api_id
  MYTGFS_PHONE   phone number for user login
  MYTGFS_2FA     2FA password (optional)
  MYTGFS_LANG    force language
